entities.summary: Tim Hecker (b. 1974-07-17, Vancouver) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Vancouver and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, composers & musicians, europe.
